description: Elections Commission - Declare that Horathal Pedige Priyantha Sisira Kumara as a member of the Uhana Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Uhana Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, specifically under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for replacing a member, including the nomination by a political party and the formal declaration by the Returning Officer. This content directly relates to electoral processes and local government elections, making it a clear fit for Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
